vlm_rejected.phrase: Lesion shows high signal intensity on T1 and T1ce sequences, with a central hypointense area on T2 and FLAIR sequences. Lesion borders are well-defined, with no apparent enhancement. Mass effect is minimal, with no visible resection cavity or midline shift.
vlm_rejected.vetoed_by: phrase denies enhancement while et_present is predicted present

sentences.text: Pre-operative multi-sequence MRI: axial T1, contrast-enhanced T1 (T1ce), T2 and FLAIR, co-registered, skull-stripped and resampled to 1 mm isotropic (BraTS preparation).
The tumour contains a necrotic / non-enhancing core (confidence 0.65). This finding is low-confidence and is hedged accordingly.
The whole-tumour mass is predominantly left-sided (confidence 1.00).
An enhancing tumour component is present (confidence 0.99).
Whole-tumour burden is assessed as medium (volume tercile fitted on the training split; confidence 0.65). This finding is low-confidence and is hedged accordingly.
The enhancing fraction of the whole tumour is mid (ET/WT tercile fitted on the training split; confidence 0.88).
Acquisition quality (cjv, efc, snr, sharpness, inu, contrast, entropy) is mildly outside the training cohort range (mean |z| = 0.64); interpret borderline findings with corresponding caution.
Automated release: case confidence 0.65 meets the calibrated gate threshold 0.55.
Key findings: ncr_present present (p=0.65); laterality left (p=1.00).
